name: first invitation
fact: An open passage leads past a closed book. No star is visible.
hope: The book may wake the first star.

name: first signal
fact: The book opened. A gold pulse answered from deeper in the passage. No star is visible yet.
action: MT watched the pages until they opened.
hope: The star answered the book; Ariadne believes they are getting closer.

name: first sighting
fact: The first star is visible ahead beyond the open book. It has not been collected.
action: MT walked far enough to see the star.
hope: Ariadne can see the star they were seeking.

name: first collection
fact: MT reached and collected the first star. Its fragment joined Ariadne.
action: MT followed the book signal and collected the star.

name: later correction

event.text: Three stars, and you sent me to another wall. I am going back to those flowers.

fact: Three stars are collected. MT has reached a dead end after following Ariadne. Closed flowers were visible at the earlier junction.
action: MT corrects Ariadne and chooses to return to the flowers.
hope: Ariadne wants to apologize, praise MT’s correction, and keep seeking the remaining star together.

name: fourth signal
fact: The flowers opened and a gold pulse answered. The fourth star is not visible yet.
action: MT returned and watched the flowers until they opened.
hope: MT’s correction led to a real star response; Ariadne believes they are close.

name: fourth sighting
fact: The fourth star is visible ahead beside the open flowers. It has not been collected.
action: MT approached the light and can see the star.
hope: Ariadne has found the last star and expects all four to restore the way home.

name: fourth collection
fact: MT collected the fourth star. All four fragments travel with Ariadne. No exit is visible.
action: MT completed the star search after correcting Ariadne’s failed route.
hope: Ariadne believes they can now restore the way home together.
